name: Grape Leaves

description: Grape leaves are a highly functional botanical green prized for their robust antioxidant profile and vascular benefits. Their matrix, rich in Vitamin A, K, and polyphenols, is engineered to suppress systemic inflammatory cascades, reinforce chronic venous tone, and safeguard cellular integrity.

healthBenefits: Venous Insufficiency: Stilbenes and flavonoids improve lower extremity microcirculation and capillary elasticity.
Inflammatory Suppression: Concentrated polyphenols reduce systemic vascular and mucosal tissue stress.
GI Detoxification: High structural fiber prevents metabolic stasis and supports colonic microbiota.
Ocular Preservation: Vitamin A carotenoids protect the macula from light-induced oxidation.
Mitochondrial Shielding: Manganese/Vitamin C pairing eliminates volatile free radicals.
precautionsIntro: Nutritional considerations regarding processing and medication interactions:
precautions: Sodium Loading: Commercial brined leaves are extremely high in salt; rinse thoroughly or prioritize fresh varieties to avoid hypertensive stress.
Oxalate Density: High oxalate content can facilitate crystal formation; restrict intake if history of calcium-oxalate kidney stones exists.
Anticoagulant Interaction: High Vitamin K levels can interfere with warfarin/coumadin; maintain consistent dietary intake if on medication.
